# temps_error_attachment_quota (Resource)

How many bytes of error attachments (screenshots, minidumps) a project may store.

Destroying the resource leaves the quota as it is.

Import with `<project_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `error_tracking:read`, `error_tracking:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_error_attachment_quota" "web" {
  project_id  = temps_project.web.id
  quota_bytes = 209715200 # 200 MiB
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `quota_bytes` (Number) Bytes of attachments the project may store.

### Read-Only

- `configured` (Boolean) Whether attachment storage is set up.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>`.
- `used_bytes` (Number) Bytes stored now.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>
terraform import temps_error_attachment_quota.web 8
```
